shortDescription: Emergent RimWorld harassment/bondage/control addon for RimJobWorld: abuse-gated conditioning with per-pawn susceptibility, a floating "Command deck" Harem window, weekly pet market, world-incident + notoriety layer (Karma integration), Tales, Ideology + Biotech integration, blackmail photos, a per-tick pawn-index performance framework, and broad mod compat.
body:
# RimJobWorld - Sexual Harassment C# addon for **RimJobWorld** (hard dep) + **Harmony**. Emergent harassment adapted from AAF Sexual Harassment (F4). Soft deps: SpeakUp, RimTalk, Karma & Reputation, c0ffee Animations, Melee Animation, [NL] Facial Animation, Onahole Extension, Rimpsyche, Modern Bio Tab, Simple Slavery Collars, BondageBed Torture, RJW Quirks/Sexperience/Genes. DLC-aware: Ideology + Biotech layers load only when active (LoadFolders IfModActive). ## Workflow rule (global) Before ANY movement/rename/delete of source files, versioned timestamped backup to `D:\Rimworld\\\`. D: = /d in git-bash. Global rules live in `_dev\GLOBAL_RULES.md` (read via bash - outside the workspace guard). Key engineering rules: **Frameworks Over Duplicated Code** (dedup, route through shared caches/bridges) and **Robust On Error** (try/catch every tick/entry point, kill-switch + fail-open). Finish work with 4 passovers + an honest 1-100% confidence score per fix. ## Facial Animation integration (FacialAnimation/Defs/FaceAnims_Harassment.xml) - loads IfModActive Nals.FacialAnimation Two classes of FaceAnimationDef: - **PERSISTENT (thought-gated):** RJWSH_FA_Nervous/_Afraid/_Hollow/_Devoted. No targetJobs (defaults to ConstantJob = ambient), but gated by `targetThoughtDefs` (+ mood range on _Hollow), so FA only shows them while the pawn carries the matching moodlet. Same pattern as FA's own Thought_Naked. - **ONE-SHOT (played from C# via FABridge.PlayTemporaryAnimation):** RJWSH_FA_Flinch/_Cry/_Bliss, priority 400. **GOTCHA (fixed):** FaceAnimationDef's ctor defaults targetJobs to ["ConstantJob"], and FA applies any ConstantJob def that has NO targetThoughtDefs to EVERY pawn every tick - so these one-shots were pinning every FA colonist's face into a permanent flinch/cry/bliss. Fix = give each a sentinel `
  • RJWSH_NeverAmbient
    • ` (not "ConstantJob", not any real JobDef defName) - removes them from all ambient lists while PlayTemporaryAnimation still works (it bypasses the job dict, adds straight to forcedTemporaryAnimationList). FABridge.PlayFace also plays FA's own job-gated "Strip" face during the strip driver. ## Performance framework (PawnIndex.cs) - NEW Central caching layer to keep TPS impact minimal (caching/dictionaries/frameworks per user request). - **Per-tick pawn index (on MapComponent_HarassmentScan):** `EnsureIndex()` rebuilds, at most once per game tick (stamp = TicksGame), a `Dictionary _byId` + snapshot lists `_humanlikes` and `_profiled`. `PawnById(id)` is O(1) (returns only still-Spawned pawns). This **killed the old O(n^2)** control upkeep (was a linear AllPawnsSpawned scan per profiled pet, every 60 ticks, to resolve `ownerId`). The upkeep loops now iterate `_profiled` (ControlUpkeep, BegUpkeep) or `_humanlikes` (ConditioningUpkeep, AffectionUpkeep) instead of every spawned thing, skipping wildlife; snapshot lists also make the loops safe if a pawn despawns mid-pass. - **PawnLookup (static):** `OnMap(map,id)` / `AnyMap(id)` route through each map's index. Replaced all 4 duplicated linear `FindPawnById` scans (MapComponent, GameComponent delivery loop, HarassmentEngine.FindPawnByIdAnyMap, Window_Harem) - the Harem window's per-row/per-frame lookups now share one build per tick instead of a full scan per pet row per OnGUI pass. - **PawnFlagCache (static, tick-scoped memo):** memoizes the hot apparel/bed predicates `WearingControlCollar` / `WearingSlaveryCollar` / `IsInOnaholeBed` (each called several times per pawn per pass across the upkeep loops). Keys are pawn ids (never Pawn refs -> no dead-Game-graph leak); store clears on tick turnover so a value is at most one tick stale; collar equip/remove sites (LockControlCollar, the free-from-control removal, UnbindVictim, ApplyAndLockDevice) call `PawnFlagCache.Invalidate` for within-tick exactness. Self-healing: a missed Invalidate is at worst a one-pass-stale bool, never a crash. Predicate bodies moved to `Compute*` methods behind static-readonly `Func` (no per-call delegate alloc). ## Performance settings (Settings.cs / Mod.cs) - NEW, conservative defaults New "Performance" section in mod options: - **enableDepthSystems** (default ON) - master toggle for the heaviest per-pet layer (rivalry/pecking/codependency/training-focus/autonomy/addiction). When OFF, core break-in progression (DepthStageTick/DepthTraumaTick) and visible hediffs (SyncAttributeHediffs) still run - only the extra interaction sim stops. - **enableAmbientBanter** (default ON) + **ambientBanterScale** (default **0.6**, conservative) - gates + scales idle pet flavor chatter (self-talk, fellow-pet, owner-slave lines). The captive "help" cry is NOT gated (gameplay signal). - **affectionInterval** (default **3000**, was hardcoded 1500 - conservative) - ambient affection roll cadence; 0 disables. - **begInterval** (default 450, unchanged - keeps help-cries responsive) - captive begging + roaming chatter cadence; 0 disables. All new fields Scribed with those defaults, so existing saves adopt the conservative values. ## EXPANSION ROADMAP (user-approved 10-idea list, phases A-E) - **A (DONE):** #7 notoriety/Karma-reputation + #1 Tales. - **B (DONE):** #2 per-pawn chronicle + #3 owner death & legacy. - **C (DONE):** #4 nemesis arc + #6 blackmail. - **D (DONE):** #8 Ideology rituals + #5 interactive training. - **E (next):** #10 Devoted endgame roles as VSE ExpertiseDefs (Bodyguard=Melee, Handler=Social, Courtesan=Sex-skill w/ Sexperience, hediff fallback without VSE) + #9 Hospitality integration. ## Target selection & attraction (HarassmentEngine.cs) `TryRunOnMap` weighted-picks a harasser (HarasserWillingness) then `FindTarget` builds a victim pool. **Sex/orientation gate = `IsAttracted(harasser,target)` (public):** absolute opposite-sex override (enforceOppositeSex/heterosexualOnly), downed-hostile opportunism ignores orientation, else RJW discrete orientation. **Approach re-validates sex:** `JobDriver_Harass` re-checks `IsAttracted` during the walk (FailOn) AND at arrival so a mid-walk sex change aborts. Player-directed grope/force bypasses the re-check. ## Interactive training (Phase D - #5 - Window_TrainingSession.cs) Setting `interactiveTraining` (default ON): the Command deck **Discipline** button opens a read-the-pet minigame. 3 rounds: pet is in a hidden state (Defiant/Fearful/Yearning) leaked by a "tell"; owner picks Firm/Gentle/Degrade. Correct match deepens conditioning + lowers subDom; misread piles trauma. Applies deltas via prof.ApplyCond + AttrDelta, logs a chronicle line. ## Ideology rituals (Phase D - #8) Two optional rites gated to the **RJWSH_Ownership meme**: collaring ceremony + devotion parade. PLAYER-initiated, ROLE-LESS gather-party, outcome worker subclasses RitualOutcomeEffectWorker_FromQuality (dodges the ritual NRE traps). Quality-scaled conditioning surge on collared pets. **UNTESTED IN-GAME - highest-risk surface.** ## Tales / Chronicle / Owner death / Nemesis / Blackmail - Tales: `TaleHelper.Record` null-guarded; 6 TaleDefs at milestones. - Chronicle: `PawnProfile.chronicle` (cap 100), History tab in Command deck. - Owner death: Harmony Postfix on Pawn.Kill -> OnOwnerDied (grief/hypnosis-shed/heir). - Nemesis: escaped/sold pets return as raid leaders (MTB by grudge). - Blackmail: photo gizmo -> faction demand; pay/refuse branches; notoriety. - Shared raid helpers: `SpawnAssaultRaid` / `PickRaidFaction`. ## Notoriety x Karma & Reputation (ReputationBridge in Bridges.cs) `AddNotoriety(amt, reason)` = local 0-100 meter + mirror -amt*3 colony infamy. World-incident pacing scales with colony regard. No-ops without Karma. ## Harem window (Window_Harem.cs) - "Command deck" FLOATING Window (Modern Suite, accent-LEFT tabs). Left roster + center STAGE / MARKET PODIUM + right OPS (Commands, Schedule, Context tabs Feed/Graph/History/[Profile]/Social) + COLONY OPS. FindPawnById now routed through PawnLookup.AnyMap. ## Pet market / Conditioning / Break stages GameComponent.market weekly; BuyMarketPawn -> collar to StrongestOrLeader. Collar SEVERITY grants Masochist/Stockholm (abuse-gated + susceptibility). BreakStage {Defiant,Wavering,Compliant,Devoted,Broken}. Escape/sale/rescue -> RegisterNemesis. ## Settings (Settings.cs / Mod.cs) masterEnabled, enableSounds, interactiveTraining, showControlTab, showSexualityTab (default OFF), hideKeyHolderGizmos, enableFleeBeating/BeatToDeath, conditioningInstallsQuirks/Gene, **Performance: enableDepthSystems, enableAmbientBanter, ambientBanterScale, affectionInterval, begInterval**, etc. ## Conventions Vanilla sentence case, ASCII hyphen only. Event.current not Input. **UI = Modern Suite.** Harmony PatchAll (astryl.RJWSexualHarassment). Rituals: player-started + role-less + FromQuality subclass ONLY. **Attraction/sex gate = HarassmentEngine.IsAttracted (public).** **Perf: id->Pawn via PawnLookup/PawnById (per-tick index), hot apparel/bed predicates via PawnFlagCache; never re-add a linear AllPawnsSpawned scan for an id lookup.** **FA: any one-shot FaceAnimationDef (played via PlayTemporaryAnimation) MUST carry a sentinel targetJobs so it stays out of FA's ambient ConstantJob rotation.** Test companions: astryl.KarmaReputation, astryl.ModernBioTab, rjw.quirks, rjw.sexperience, Vegapnk.rjw.genes, TRIBeagle.simpleslaverycollars, Mlie.BondageBedTorture (+ Ludeon.RimWorld.Ideology).
